description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Tool Registry Service (TRS), shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-trs` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Read a GA4GH Tool Registry Service (TRS) registry: search registered bioinformatics tools (workflows and command-line tools), inspect one tool and its versions, and retrieve a version's descriptor, secondary descriptor files, test parameter files, file listing, and container build recipes. Use when the user asks to find a registered CWL/WDL/Nextflow tool or workflow, look up a tool's versions or descriptor types, or fetch a registered workflow's source or tests.
